Single visual idea: building the foundations of computation through a clear BINARY TREE SCULPTURE made from modular geometric building blocks. Exactly seven chunky nodes in three levels (one root at the top, two middle nodes, four leaves along the bottom), with exactly two clean structural branches from each parent to its children, all visually unambiguous and noncrossing. All nodes use the same rounded-cube vocabulary. The four lower nodes sit firmly on one low stepped rectangular footing built from those same blocks; the parent nodes and branches form a single sturdy architectonic sculpture. This one coherent tree is the entire subject, representing data structures and structured thinking. No processor, memory bars, coordinate axes, code brackets, books or unrelated props. Rich warm palette: dusty apricot background, persimmon-orange and pale butter-yellow nodes, deep burgundy branches, low muted coral plinth. Use complementary warm colors and dark structural contrast. The tree should fill the center boldly, with clean margins; no awkward tangent intersections.

assets.title: AI 研发与应用
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished 4:3 landscape cover illustration (1448x1086 preferred) for the AI-assisted game development section of GameDevMind, a professional engineering knowledge library. Attached image is a STYLE reference only: maintain its isometric miniature scene, matte tactile clay/painted metal materials, softly rounded geometric forms, gentle upper-left studio lighting, natural contact shadows, clear simple silhouettes and low thin display plinth. Design a NEW cohesive scene and palette. Single central idea: a HUMAN DEVELOPER and a SMALL FRIENDLY AI ASSISTANT ROBOT working side-by-side at ONE SHARED GAME-DEVELOPMENT WORKBENCH. One broad monitor physically attached to the desk displays a simple isometric game level consisting of a short cream-tile path, two green trees, a tiny character and an arch. A narrow integrated strip at the bottom of this same screen has three simple completed checkpoints, shown as geometric ticks without words, representing review and validation. The human developer at the left points at the game scene on the monitor while the robot at the right uses the one shared keyboard directly below it; both clearly attend to the same project. The developer makes decisions and reviews, the assistant helps execute. The robot is a compact teal tabletop or seated humanoid with a rounded rectangular head and two simple dark eyes, no antenna, no tool arms or excessive panels. The human is a simplified faceless sculptural figure with natural hands, wearing a dark navy top. Exactly one human, one robot, one monitor and one coherent desk. All equipment is physically supported, all arms plausible, no tangled cables. No standalone gears, chips, brain icons, circuit networks, disconnected floating panels, speech bubbles or decorative AI sparkles. Distinct rich complementary palette: dusty rose-pink seamless background, deep raspberry/burgundy desk and monitor frame, turquoise-teal robot, warm cream tabletop and human head, tiny golden-yellow accents. Make the game level the shared focal point; gestures guide attention toward it. Calm practical collaboration rather than science fiction. Strong legibility at thumbnail size; generous outer margins, entire scene visible with no cropping. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, borders or grid. Output one image only.
